text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Teehee! No matter how many times I<n>see it, I never
fail to be charmed by<n>my cute little beauty mark. It
really<n>accentuates my face!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If having one already makes me thisalluring, then adding more mightpossibly make me even more charming...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh... This isn't what I had imagined at<n>all! Wait... It's
not coming off! Don't<n>tell me this is a permanent
marker?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl covers her face<n>with makeup in
an attempt to conceal<n>the pen marks on her face,
but she's<n>so self-conscious about her<n>appearance
that she can't<n>concentrate for the rest of the day.
